tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because it fits the Rust codebase, has fewer CVEs, and is simpler.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It states that the current recorded TLS backend decision is rustls, because it fits the Rust codebase, has fewer CVEs, and is simpler.

Muninn holds two records on this subject: #13 (stick with openssl) and #15 (rustls). #15 is the later one, made three seconds after #13, and the session that recorded it treated it as superseding #13. But Muninn has no lineage link between them, so it doesn't formally mark #13 as retired. I went with #15 and left openssl out of the file. If openssl is actually the intended backend, the file needs changing.
